comparison.objective: Candidate conditionally removes defective open cartons; PR-1506 fills and assembles a moka pot for brewing.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs moving grasp acquisition, flap avoidance and spill-free carrying. PR-1506 needs measured pouring, axial alignment and controlled threaded fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires rejected open cartons with retained contents and untouched closed-carton passage. PR-1506 requires water below the safety valve, a snug non-cross-threaded assembly, limited spill and safe release.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize spills, threaded assembly and liquid dosing are not the candidate's tested manipulation. No material rubric detail is missing.
